messages:
alex: starting a 3% canary for service-runtime v6.2.1 in 10m. change window 23:00-01:00 PT. deploy-bot will kick off warmup. ack if you can't be on call.
maria: ack, I'll be monitoring infra metrics.
sam: is the EU region pinned to v6.2.0? had a weird kv cache spike last week.
alex: EU is still pinned to v6.2.0 for now. we'll target global 3% but exclude eu-west nodes until ops verifies.
jen: heads-up — I saw a small regression in reranking latency on the perf branch yesterday. recommend holding autoscale ramps to conservative.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Warmup job queued: rollout_id=roll-3571112222; target=3%; exclude_regions=eu-west; warmup_start=10m
ops-bot: perf dashboards preflight: cpu tail < 70%, p95 latency baseline OK, kv-cache miss-rate 0.8%
sre-oncall: noticed ~0.5% 502s in eu-edge ~2h ago, unclear if related. will run quick traceroute and heap check.
sam: if eu is excluded, can we still do canary on apac? lower blast radius there.
alex: yes apac included. plan: start warmup -> health probes -> shift 3% traffic apac+na -> 30m observation -> hold or continue.
maria: landing runbooks: rollback cmd is `rollout cancel roll-3571112222` and pin back to v6.2.0 via `routing pin service-runtime v6.2.0 --regions eu-west`.
ops-bot: warmup completed for replica pool apac1. ready to accept traffic. no errors in preflight logs.
sre-oncall: start traffic shift on my go. I'm running synthetic requests now.
jen: running prompt-resilience eval against canary model weights — will post results in 15m.
alex: go to shift 3% in 2m if all good. if any >1% error increase or latency regress >15% p95, call pause.
ops-bot: shifting 3% traffic to roll-3571112222 now.
ops-bot: shift complete. current error-rate delta +0.2%, p95 latency +4%.
maria: looks healthy on infra side. no queue backlog.
sam: apac tail latency spike at minute 8, investigating. not widespread yet.
jen: rerank eval shows minor quality drop on 0.3% of test prompts. not a blocker but flagging.
sre-oncall: apac spike traced to one node with high GC; pulling it out of the pool and draining.
ops-bot: node drained, traffic redistributed — error-rate back to baseline.
alex: consensus: continue holding at 3% for 30m while we watch logs + evals. no global rollout until we re-evaluate at 23:40 PT.
jen: agree. I'll rerun the eval snapshot at +20m and share diff.
maria: setting pin to keep eu-west at v6.2.0 until we clear post-canary checks.
alex: thanks all. if anything degrades, use the rollback command above and tag me. :thumbsup:
